title: Aoyagi Toya — Tracing Brilliant Memories〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you both for agreeing to practice with me today, MEIKO, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The others may also be done practicing and making their way over to the cafe.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
So, I'll be excusing myself here.
See you two in a little bit.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, why don't we take the scenic route back?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, in that case, would you like to head over to the plaza?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'd like to check up on the tree.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Right.
I can certainly understand why you'd like to make sure it's doing okay.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: After all, it's only natural to worry about something your feelings created!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you. I feel that we should make sure it's doing okay since it just underwent a tremendous growth spurt.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Ahem!
I'm all for that, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ever since we came into contact with those black fragments, I keep thinking...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What if things went differently that day?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
What do your true feelings tell you right now?
Do you really not want to do this with me anymore?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Is there no part of you that wants to get up on that stage with me?! If there is, then somewhere in there you must have the same dream of surpassing RAD WEEKEND that I have!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What if we hadn't told each other how we actually felt?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: What if that nightmare were real, and this were all a dream?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hmm... That's a difficult one to unravel.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But you managed to wake up from that terrible dream, so I wouldn't worry too much about any what ifs.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
But I feel a little too lucky right now...
I fear that I'm going to wake up and realize that this was all a dream.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Stop right there for me, Toya.
Now, turn your back towards me.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm going to be your alarm!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Whenever you feel that this is all a big dream, Toya, then come talk to me. I'll be there to wake you up.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: By slapping your back and saying, “Good morning!”

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So, let's try to enjoy the present!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's right! The future starts with the present, does it not?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Which is why I believe it's important to enjoy the present. The more fun you have now, the brighter your future will be!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: However, based on your personality, you'll also need to keep reminding yourself about how you truly feel from time to time.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, did that ring a bell?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes...
I just remembered something very important.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: During that dream, I think I heard all your voices...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You did?! You heard us calling your name?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We actually kept shouting your names the whole time to try and get you all to wake up.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Now you know.
Rin and Len shouted so much, I thought they were going to lose their voices.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
You should go thank them later.
I'm sure they'll really appreciate it.
